headline: Gaza Health Ministry updates toll
dek: Gaza's Health Ministry says 11 Palestinians were killed and 38 wounded in Israeli attacks over a 48-hour period; 2 others died of wounds from previous attacks and 2 bodies were recovered from rubble. Since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, at least 1,593 Palestinians have been killed and…
sources: Gaza Health Ministry statement, via Al Jazeera liveblog
fault_line: Is this still a 'ceasefire' when its own toll rises by 13 in 48 hours — or is the ceasefire label itself the fiction?

sections.what_happened: Gaza's Health Ministry says 11 Palestinians were killed and 38 wounded in Israeli attacks over a 48-hour period; 2 others died of wounds from previous attacks and 2 bodies were recovered from rubble. Since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, at least 1,593 Palestinians have been killed and 5,748 injured, with another 847 bodies recovered from under debris. The total toll since October 2023 now stands at 74,609 killed and 175,872 wounded. ARITHMETIC CHECK vs Sunday prints: ceasefire toll 1,580 (Reuters Monday wire) + 11 killed + 2 died of wounds = 1,593; total 74,594 (Sunday reports) + 11 + 2 + 2 bodies recovered = 74,609. The update is internally consistent with the prior prints. This supersedes the 1,583 figure in 1400-01 (different reporting window/source count) and the 1,580 Reuters figure in 1200-04.
sections.what_verified: Gaza Health Ministry statement carried by Al Jazeera liveblog (single family). The ministry is the primary source of its own toll; AJ is the carrier, so this is recorded as one family, not two.
sections.what_disputed: IDF says its Gaza strikes target militants (Reuters Monday wire, 1200-04); Israel says 4 of its soldiers have been killed in the same ceasefire period. The ministry's figures are considered reliable by the UN per prior wire reporting, but no independent recount of this update exists in-window.
sections.why_matters: The ceasefire toll just moved again: 1,593 killed since October 2025, 74,609 since October 2023 — and the 48-hour update alone added 11 dead and 38 wounded.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 11:00 GMT = 15:00 ) -- Gaza Health Ministry updates toll: 11 killed, 38 wounded in 48 hours; ceasefire-period toll now 1,593; total war toll 74,609

totw_analysis: Our read: The ceasefire toll just moved again: 1,593 killed since October 2025, 74,609 since October 2023 — and the 48-hour update alone added 11 dead and 38 wounded. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is this still a 'ceasefire' when its own toll rises by 13 in 48 hours — or is the ceasefire label itself the fiction?
